help: install a peer machine's transported sessions (the one deliberate writer of ~/.claude/projects)

args.name: --session
args.help: uuid(8) prefix of the agent to install — identity is never guessed

args.name: --all
args.help: install every session the peer transported (pull --all from one machine)

args.name: --from
args.help: the peer to receive from — a machine name (bare token) or a directory (./dir), by shape not CWD lookup

args.name: --apply
args.help: perform the merge — without it, a dry run that only reports
